final: WITH grouped AS (SELECT cr.raceId, c.country, SUM(cr.points) AS points_sum, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM constructorResults AS cr JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cr.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY cr.raceId, c.country), average_count AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count FROM grouped) SELECT g.raceId, g.country, g.points_sum, g.record_count, g.record_count - a.avg_count AS count_minus_average FROM grouped AS g CROSS JOIN average_count AS a WHERE a.avg_count IS NOT NULL AND g.record_count > a.avg_count ORDER BY count_minus_average DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
